Collapsing them is how a restarted watch silently becomes a fresh one that has 'seen nothing changed' since a beginning it invented. Timeline behind it: a host-client reconnect at 09:58:38Z on 2026-07-26 restarted the session process and dropped the pending wakeup; three PRs opened into the gap and the watch reported healthy for 44 minutes (quince-devlog#13). SINCE quince#58 THE REPORT ALSO CARRIES event=unreconciled: tick-overdue names the gap, and this line says the catch-up cannot account for what happened inside it — a state diff compares endpoints, so a PR that opened AND closed in there leaves no trace. Without it the pair reads as a complete account of the interval.
